name: codex-hud
description: Status bars, a project panel, and worker delegation for Claude Code, Codex, pi, and Antigravity

scripts.test:render: npm run build && node bin/hud-dist.mjs bar
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run build:test && npm run test:unit && npm run test:mjs
scripts.test:mcp: TZ=UTC node --test tests/unit/thin-mcp-*.test.mjs tests/unit/hud-watch.test.mjs tests/unit/cli-judge.test.mjs tests/unit/job-retention*.test.mjs
scripts.test:panel: TZ=UTC node --test tests/unit/panel-*.test.mjs tests/unit/project-*.test.mjs tests/unit/home-*.test.mjs tests/unit/control-*.test.mjs tests/unit/role-*.test.mjs tests/unit/kept-pages.test.mjs tests/unit/card-*.test.mjs
scripts.test:fast: npm run test:unit && TZ=UTC node --test tests/unit/card-*.test.mjs tests/unit/cleanup-views.test.mjs tests/unit/cli-judge.test.mjs tests/unit/home-*.test.mjs tests/unit/html-board.test.mjs tests/unit/kept-pages.test.mjs tests/unit/model-picker*.test.mjs tests/unit/panel-filter.test.mjs tests/unit/panel-keys-rows.test.mjs tests/unit/project-hub.test.mjs tests/unit/project-layout-*.test.mjs tests/unit/role-presets.test.mjs tests/unit/roster-invalid.test.mjs tests/unit/skills-tab.test.mjs tests/unit/themes.test.mjs tests/unit/waiting-settled.test.mjs
scripts.preview:png: npm run build && npm run build:test && node scripts/preview-png.mjs
scripts.snapshots:update: npm run build && npm run build:test && node scripts/update-snapshots.mjs
